source_name: OpenStreetMap API map extract filtered to KAUO aeroway ways
element_timestamps: Individual OSM way and node versions/timestamps are retained in the selected artifact; these differ by object.
crs: WGS 84 geographic coordinates, EPSG:4326, OSM node attributes lat/lon
source_type: crowd-sourced vector map; supporting evidence only
license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; attribution to OpenStreetMap contributors required
authority_classification: SOURCE_DERIVED supporting source; not an official airport or survey dataset
extraction_method: Retain only aeroway=taxiway, runway, and apron ways and their referenced nodes; remove unrelated surrounding address/building tags; preserve relevant way tags and element IDs/timestamps
limitations: No horizontal positional accuracy or authoritative survey lineage is published for the retained ways.
OSM way geometry is used only as medium-confidence source-derived context and is excluded from production routing.
One mapped taxiway way does not intersect an ALDOT mapped taxiway pavement section and is quarantined from the candidate network.
